description: `cli wallet usage --help` states the service's default window (--start 30 days ago, --end today, UTC) and prints its manifest examples.

stdout.text:
Usage: prose [GLOBAL OPTIONS] cli wallet usage [OPTIONS]

Summarize run usage and prices by day.

Options:
  --start YYYY-MM-DD          First day. Default: 30 days ago (UTC).
  --end YYYY-MM-DD            Last day. Default: today (UTC).
  --json                      Print one JSON result; the same as the global --output json.
  --help                      Show help for this command.

Examples:
  prose cli wallet usage --start 2026-09-01 --end 2026-09-24 --json

Output: openprose.service-operation/1 (--json).
Exit codes: 0 success; 2 invalid invocation or configuration; 10 service or credential error; 24 interrupted.
